Terms of Use

What this site is

BuyVsRent.xyz is a free educational calculator that models the long-term financial trade-off between buying a home and renting while investing. It is provided as-is, free of charge, for informational purposes.

Not financial advice

Nothing on this site constitutes financial, investment, tax, legal, or real-estate advice. The calculator produces estimates driven entirely by assumptions you control — small changes in assumptions can flip the outcome, and no model can predict actual market returns, home prices, rents, tax law, or your personal circumstances. Before making housing or investment decisions, consult qualified professionals who know your situation.

No warranty

We work hard to keep the math correct and document every formula, but we provide no warranty of any kind — express or implied — regarding accuracy, completeness, or fitness for a particular purpose. Tax rules in particular are simplified models of current U.S. law and change over time; other countries' rules differ. To the maximum extent permitted by law, BuyVsRent and its operators are not liable for any loss arising from use of this site.

Acceptable use

You may link to, share, and embed results freely, including for commercial commentary. You may not scrape the site in a way that degrades service, misrepresent its outputs as guarantees, or present the tool as offering personalized financial advice.
